name: Kateinai Choukyou
source:
Main character lives alone after losing his parents. But one day his less than lover more than friend Tomomi's parents go bankrupt. To save his friend from sacrificing herself he needs either a huge sum of money or fulfilling several creditor's conditions. One of them is to train girl of the family as masochist in just two months before her marriage.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角失去父母后独自生活。但有一天，他与其说是情人，不如说是朋友，友美的父母破产了。为了避免他的朋友牺牲自己，他要么需要一大笔钱，要么满足几个债权人的条件。其中之一就是在出嫁前两个月就将家里的女孩训练成受虐狂。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
